props.name: aria-hidden
props.description: Hides the cap from screen readers, which read it otherwise. Set it when the cap only repeats a shortcut that its control declares in `aria-keyshortcuts`.

props.name: children
props.description: The key: a word such as `Esc`, a glyph such as `⌘`, or an icon. Kbd never detects the platform, so the server and the browser render the same cap. Pass `⌘` or `Ctrl` yourself where your app knows the platform.

props.name: children
props.description: The `Kbd` caps of one combination, pressed together. In an `InputGroup` addon, make the group, or a lone cap, the addon's direct child, so the caps round with the addon's inner corner.
